context.person: A person using an AI-assisted report editor
context.journey_stage: AI draft contains an unsupported claim
context.user_goal: Remove or replace the claim using verified source material.

known_facts: The 18% figure has no supporting source.

challenge: Rewrite the in-product banner so the person can understand ai draft contains an unsupported claim, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.secondary_action: Remove the sentence from the draft.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: Publishing the draft would present an unverified metric as fact.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Remove or replace the claim using verified source material.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
